findings.observed: The RDS database instance is replaced because `storage_encrypted` (false → true) cannot be changed in place. No final snapshot will be taken (`skip_final_snapshot` = true); deletion protection is off.
findings.recommendation: If the change is intended, take a snapshot or backup first and plan the cutover. If the replacement is a surprise, revert `storage_encrypted`. `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` makes Terraform refuse a plan like this.
findings.title: `aws_db_instance.app` will be destroyed and recreated, losing the database and everything stored in it

privacy.note: tfimpact runs locally. Nothing is sent anywhere; sensitive values are masked.
